description: Sine oscillator and simple voice — several patched together make the classic FM algorithms

params.text: Frequency knob is a ratio of the pitch at V/OCT, so one pitch CV drives a stack of operators at set intervals
Trims the pitch by as much as a semitone either way
Fires the onboard ADSR, which can be routed to level, feedback or depth
Self-modulation of the sine, with a CV

inputs.text: Fires the onboard ADSR, which can be routed to level, feedback or depth
Self-modulation of the sine, with a CV
Frequency knob is a ratio of the pitch at V/OCT, so one pitch CV drives a stack of operators at set intervals
The signal that modulates the frequency, linear and through zero, at the depth set by DEPTH

outputs.text: The sine wave, at the level set by LEVEL

menu: Oscillator mode — Classic (extra harmonics) reads the sine table without interpolation; Clean (pure sine) interpolates it
Linear level response — the LEVEL knob and its CV act linearly in amplitude rather than in decibels
Anti-alias feedback — filters the feedback path against aliasing; turning it off is part of the pre-1.1.36 sound
Anti-alias external FM — filters the signal at FM against aliasing; turning it off restores the behaviour the module had before version 1.1.36
